title: Reduction of Sperm DNA Fragmentation by Oral Ginger
brief_summary: This study is a randomized, double blind, controlled clinical trials assess the efficacy of the ginger oral treatment on sperm DNA fragmentation, sperm parameters and male hormones.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* men with idiopathic infertility or unexplained

Exclusion Criteria:

* history of varicocele, genitourinary inflammation or infection
* history of cigarette smoking.
